jobs.occupation: Senior Electronics PCB & ECAD Design Engineer - RF & Mixed Signal (m/f/d) (Forschungs- und Entwicklungsingenieur/in)
jobs.description: RoleHive Robotics is building Europe’s first full-stack orchestration platform for unmanned systems: connecting, controlling, and commanding multi-vendor drone and robot swarms. Our RF communication systems are Made in Germany, deployed on active frontlines, and targeting a highly valued tactical communication market with zero sovereign alternatives today.As our Senior Electronics Hardware Engineer, you own our electronic designs end to end: from requirements through schematic capture, PCB layout, and manufacturing release to bring-up and debugging. You take a hardware requirement and independently turn it into a robust, manufacturable PCB assembly, spot problems early, and keep projects moving without waiting for direction. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. Most importantly, you enjoy designing hardware yourself and seeing it ship. You report into our CTO organization.Bring-up, rework, and close work with mechanical, firmware, and production happen hands-on in our Munich office, so we expect you on site most days of the week.ResponsibilitiesSchematic & PCB Design- Own electronic hardware designs from requirements to manufacturing release, including schematics and design reviews- Select components based on performance, availability, lifecycle, cost, and manufacturability- Place and route multilayer boards, and define stack-ups, design rules, controlled-impedance requirements, and layout constraints- Review designs for manufacturability, reliability, EMC, signal and power integrity, and thermal behavior where relevant- Design with certification in mind: support EMC and radio (CE/RED) pre-compliance and certification testing with external labs, and feed the findings back into the designECAD Libraries & Engineering Data- Create and maintain schematic symbols, footprints, padstacks, and ECAD libraries- Define and maintain electrical, physical, and manufacturing design rule sets- Keep engineering data clean: design documentation, revision history, and versioning that let anyone pick up a design later and improve it- Improve engineering workflows and automate repetitive tasks where it pays offManufacturing & Supply- Generate, review, and release manufacturing outputs and technical documentation- Work directly with PCB fabrication and PCBA assembly partners on stack-ups, fabrication constraints, assembly guidelines, and production requirements- Review BOMs and qualify alternative components based on availability, lifecycle, and technical requirements, together with Operations- Make sure designs scale from prototype runs to serial production volumesBring-up, Test & Integration- Bring up, debug, and validate boards, including burn-in testing, soldering, and rework- Work closely with mechanical and embedded firmware engineers through design, integration, and bring-up- Reproduce and qualify hardware issues from production and the field so they get fixed at the root cause- Handle sensitive and export-controlled design data in line with our dual-use export
